criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name subject, role, and the concrete Sept. 1 vote; 'Just under $600,000 moved before the rules for the system did' makes the decision itself the hook with a real stake inside the see-more window. Decision-led, not bio-led.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Elected decision-owner; concrete consequence stated (municipal surveillance/AI governance, $598,998.10 Thundercat contract, federal forfeiture funding, named actors APD/Thundercat/residents, Sept. 15 timeframe). Both sides carry weight; nothing thin.

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name + role + Anchorage Assembly affiliation, Anchorage tie explicit via Eagle River seat. Every fact matches the dossier. Docks one for compressing role/org into a single loose phrase rather than stating Eagle River sits inside the Municipality.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: Names what (fund RTCC expansion), when (Sept. 1), and the binary Goecker owned (fund now vs. adopt the ordinance first, 8-4, four opponents named). Traces to Alaska Public Media primary and survives multi-source. Date within window.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Honest, proportionate position: credits the vote as 'a legitimate governing position rather than a talking point,' then names the evidence-backed sequencing risk of capability installed two weeks ahead of its rules. Not neutral, not boosterism, not manufactured criticism.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the next owned decision (Goecker's vote on the surveillance-and-privacy ordinance), the date (Sept. 15), and exactly what to watch (constrain, water down, or defer). Reader knows what to revisit this month.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, business-literate, plain language without dumbing down. No press-release cadence, no hagiography, no influencer tics. Reads like the post_001 register.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 444 words, 2850 chars, bio minimal. Paragraph four (Goecker/DPS report/quote/roster) packs several facts into one dense block that slows the mobile scan; otherwise tight 2-4 sentence paragraphs.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes on a genuine, debatable question tied to the specific decision (fund two weeks ahead vs. tie the money to the rules). No CTA, no rhetorical softener.

criteria.name: Credibility guard
criteria.notes: Grounded independent analysis; bio recap minimal, decision treatment dominant; every claim traceable to corroborated evidence and inline outlet attribution. Praise and risk are both earned by the record.

one_sentence_fix: Split the dense fourth paragraph so the DPS property-crime figure, the on-record quote, and the four-member no roster sit in separate 2-3 sentence beats for easier mobile scanning.
